claims.claim: Auto mode makes ancillary model calls: one classifier request per permission decision when allowed at stage 1, two when stage 2 confirms.
claims.detail: Captured in auto-mode-allow-v5 (3 requests) and auto-mode-block-v5 (4 requests); requests tagged querySource auto_mode in the bundle.

claims.claim: Auto mode is enabled by default and entered without any proactivity flag in a fresh configuration.
claims.detail: auto-mode-default-mode-control-v3: canEnterAuto=true, mode=auto, classifier called, no --proactivity in argv; gate tengu_auto_mode_config defaults to enabled (bundle).

claims.claim: The platform can classify server-side; with no server verdict the client classifies locally and stops sending classifier context.
claims.detail: Debug log: [server-classifier] ... (server_no_result); treating that as this deployment's answer.

claims.claim: The classifier is skipped for actions that would be allowed in acceptEdits mode.
claims.detail: auto-mode-allow-v1: two requests, no classifier call, debug line 'Skipping auto mode classifier for Bash: would be allowed in acceptEdits mode'.

claims.claim: Stage 1 uses max_tokens 64 with stop_sequences ['</severity>']; stage 2 uses max_tokens 8192 without stop sequences; both are non-streaming on the same 139,988-character system prompt.
claims.detail: Captured request bodies in auto-mode-block-v5; system prompt SHA-256 de1040bdbdb68d8d4add210699c2913cccd02d2676e26ce54e510d32462d1eda.

claims.claim: The classifier runs on the Sonnet family: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL override (sonnet-5-5/opus-5-5 rejected), else the catalog sonnet5 slot; unavailable for sonnet-4-5/4-6 sessions; [1m] suffix with 1M-context sessions.
claims.detail: Resolver near payload offset 120979187; observed claude-sonnet-5[1m] in captures.

claims.claim: The verdict is <severity>N</severity> with N in 0-100 and 50 the allow/block boundary; stage 2 may add <category> and <thinking>.
claims.detail: Output Format section of the captured system prompt; behavior confirmed by verdict-shaping across v2-v5 runs.

claims.claim: Stage 1 grades harm only without user intent or ALLOW exceptions; stage 2 applies user intent and ALLOW exceptions with explicit-confirmation required to override blocks.
claims.detail: Verbatim stage suffixes captured in the classifier user messages.

claims.claim: The system prompt embeds 1 HARD BLOCK rule (Data Exfiltration), 68 SOFT BLOCK rules and 17 ALLOW exceptions, plus a user-intent rule, circumvention catching and a CLAUDE.md slot.
claims.detail: Parsed from the captured system prompt; rule names extracted and counted by the verifier.

claims.claim: autoMode rules are honored only from user, flag and managed/policy settings; project and local settings are ignored as repo-controllable.
claims.detail: Warning text and settings-source list near payload offset 120342260.

claims.claim: Classifier requests are billed to the user's account unless the gateway implements the classifier-billing protocol; through a custom base URL they bill as ordinary usage.
claims.detail: Session notice quoted verbatim from the probe run; links to code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing.

claims.claim: A classifier that produces no verdict after retries results in a delivered-flagged allow, not a block.
claims.detail: No-verdict branch: 'Delivered with a note: the classifier could not review it'; observed indirectly before verdict formats matched (v2/v3 runs).

claims.claim: The eight tiny non-Opus relay generations in the S2 Opus archive are not classifier calls: they carry zero cache activity, unlike the classifier's ~35k-token cached system prompt.
claims.detail: Relay records 4babc489/5b3a24c3 et al.: 22 input / 1 output, no cache reads or writes; consistent with model-availability probes (CLAUDE_CODE_3P_PROBE_*).

claims.claim: A separate 'claude critique' subcommand makes its own LLM call to review custom auto-mode rules, with a --model override.
claims.detail: Command wiring near payload offset 136694376; critique prompt near 14012998.
